acquisition_method.evidence: Data-dependent acquisition was performed using the Xcalibur 2.3 software in positive ion mode at a spray voltage of 2.1 kV.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: followed by alkylation with 30 mM iodoacetamine at room temperature for 2 h

alkylation_reagent.evidence: followed by alkylation with 30 mM iodoacetamine at room temperature for 2 h

cleavage_agent.evidence: An aliquot of Lys-C/Trypsin solution (Promega, Madison, WI) was added into each sample at the 100:1 protein: enzyme ratio.

collision_energy.evidence: For all higher-energy collisional dissociation scans, collision energy was set to 30%

enrichment_method.evidence: The remaining 90% of each SCX fraction was subjected to immobilized metal affinity chromatography (IMAC) for enrichment of phosphopeptides.

fractionation_method.evidence: The strong cation exchange chromatography of iTRAQ labeled peptides was performed as described previously with some modifications.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The top 15 ions in each survey scan were selected for higher-energy collisional dissociation scans with a resolution of 17,500.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Data-dependent acquisition was performed using the Xcalibur 2.3 software in positive ion mode at a spray voltage of 2.1 kV.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: analyzed on a Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA)

reduction_concentration.evidence: The proteins were first reduced with 10 mM DTT at room temperature for 30 min
